title: STAR - Simulation Telemetry Analytics & Racing
summary: A private sim-racing race-strategy tool: live telemetry ingestion, race-plan/pace targets (push/save/recovery/in-lap/out-lap), session history, and an AI strategy assistant, built on .NET/Avalonia UI. Current focus is a UI revamp (ui-revamp branch) reworking the race-brief and strategy screens shown below.
